values.name: The total arable land does not include greenhouse kitchen gardens ( 275 hectares)
The item considers all holdings with at least one other gainful activity among the types indicated

Energy from non-fossil renewable sources, i.e. wind, solar, aerothermal, geothermal, hydrothermal and ocean energy, hydraulics, biomass, landfill gas, waste gases from purification processes and biogas. (Legislative Decree 28/2011)
The item considers all holdings with at least one investment among the types indicated

The holder of the agricultural holding is the natural person, group of natural persons or legal person on whose account and in whose name the holding is operated and who is legally and economically responsible for the holding, i.e. who takes the economic risks of the holding. In case of a family holding, and for other legal forms, the holder can coincide with the farm manager.
Family members: persons aged 16 and over linked by ties of marriage, friendship, affinity, adoption, guardianship or emotional ties, cohabiting and having habitual residence in the same Municipality.
Relatives of the holder: descendants, ascendants and other relatives related to the holder, not living together, aged 16 and over.
The item includes: the holder, the holder's spouse who works on the farm, other family members of the holder who work on the farm, relatives of the holder who work on the farm

Regarding farms, the modality reports the number farms with at least one type of cattle among the indicated items. Regarding heads the modality is calculeted in LSU - a standard measurement unit that allows the aggregation of the various categories of livestock of various species and age, via the use of specific coefficients established on the basis of the nutritional or feed requirement of each type of animal, in order to enable a comparison. The coefficients are adopted in accordance with Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2018/1091.
For poultry, the average annual number is calculated by adding the number of animals present in each cycle and dividing this value by the number of cycles.

The farm manager is the natural person who ensures the current and daily management of the agricultural holding. For each holding, only one person is considered to be the manager. In case of a family holding, and for other legal forms, the farm manager can coincide with the farm holder.
Number of agricultural holdings that made investments in the three-year period 2018 - 2020.

Other gainful activities are remunerative activities, which therefore generate income for the holding, directly connected to agricultural activities, in which the holding's resources (land, buildings, machinery, labour, etc.) or holding products are used. Activities carried out as a hobby or non-profit are therefore excluded. They can be carried out both within the holding and externally (as in the case of active contracting or forestry services).

Standardized working days (i.e. eight-hour days) carried out on the farm for the agricultural activities during the agricultural year. The farm manager is the natural person who ensures the current and daily management of the agricultural holding. For each holding, only one person is considered to be the manager. In case of a family holding, and for other legal forms, it can coincide with the farm holder.
